thread.title: Fewer Americans Shopped During Thanksgiving Weekend in 2018

title: Fewer Americans Shopped During Thanksgiving Weekend in 2018
text:
Fewer Americans Shopped During Thanksgiving Weekend in 2018 Nov. 27, 2018, at 1:30 p.m. A large crowd of people shop during a Black Friday sales event at Macy's flagship store on 34th St. in New York City, U.S., November 22, 2018. REUTERS/Stephanie Keith Reuters
NEW YORK (Reuters) - More than 165 million U.S. shoppers made purchases over the five-day Thanksgiving weekend, the National Retail Federation said on Tuesday, beating the industry group's expectations this year but lower than last year.
More than 174 million U.S. shoppers made purchases during the same period last year, the retail trade body said.
(Reporting by Nandita Bose in New York; Editing by Nick Zieminski)
